summary: Off-highway vehicle with four occupants left the roadway and rolled ~100 ft down a steep embankment in Arrastra Gulch about 2 miles north of Silverton; 17-member SMR team built a technical rope raising system; two occupants pronounced dead at scene, two transported to Mercy Regional Medical Center (one by ambulance, one by Flight for Life)
location: Arrastra Gulch, ~2 mi N of Silverton
responding_agency: Silverton Medical Rescue; San Juan County Sheriff's Office; Silverton San Juan County Volunteer Fire Department; Flight for Life
notes: post dated 2026-08-06; incident stated as Aug 3 ~3 p.m.
